the rational design and preparation of nitrogen doped porous carbon materials, which can be used as efficient electrocatalysts and electrode materials for zinc air batteries and symmetric supercapcitors, respectively.
the design and fabrication of a novel nitrogen doped porous carbon with excellent electrochemical performance.
